question: In a certain code language, 'PREMIUM' is written as 'ILZIFSL'. How will 'GENIOUS' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 'PREMIUM' is written as 'ILZIFSL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49061d1392b4a8fca7bec934d0a4a14ee89088e128e88585de564a0e1747f501.png] 

Similarly,

'GENIOUS' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d559f50932d7c7b507a664c9a82104a984e565c8558cf797c4e4c2a9eed4ceb8.png] 

Hence, '​GENIOUS' is coded as "ZYIELSR".
